scripts.build: astro check && astro build && node scripts/generate-security-headers.mjs dist && node scripts/generate-service-worker.mjs dist && npm run public:artifact-check
scripts.api:check: npm run api:smoke && ANISONARY_REQUIRE_API_DATA=true npm run build
scripts.check: npm run public:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run cf:check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_SEND_ERROR_REPORTS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/anisonary-wrangler-logs wrangler dev
scripts.cf:preview: npm run build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_SEND_ERROR_REPORTS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/anisonary-wrangler-logs wrangler versions upload
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_SEND_ERROR_REPORTS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/anisonary-wrangler-logs wrangler deploy
